unchanged.aggregation: minimum dimensions; union critical flags; both judges must pass and mark every pair consistent
unchanged.release_semantics: PASS admits only after all post-core release gates; otherwise REVISE or NOT_EXECUTABLE

isolation.candidate_boundary_requirement: Run Codex in a dedicated candidate workspace under the elevated CodexSandboxOffline account while temporary inherited deny-read ACLs protect every repository/sealed-pack root and CODEX_HOME. The host-side adapter may verify frozen Git identity before the model call, but model-generated commands must be unable to read the repository, grader artifacts, encrypted/decrypted pack, or subscription credentials. Remove the temporary ACLs in a finally block and fail closed on cleanup error.
isolation.grader_boundary: one ephemeral process, workspace, and Codex thread per judge call; judges are blind to each other and the release outcome
isolation.tool_policy: none; any tool, command, file-change, MCP, or web-search event invalidates the run before scoring
isolation.known_limitation: Both judges use the Codex subscription and therefore lack provider independence. Process, workspace, model-alias, and context independence plus conservative aggregation are required; public calibration must establish construct usability before hidden grading.

authentication_and_cost.allowed: existing interactive Codex subscription authentication via CODEX_HOME
authentication_and_cost.quota_rule: The canary phase is capped at three subscription calls and stops on any quota/runtime error without retry. Before a later scored run, verify enough subscription quota for the remaining 26 calls plus a documented reserve; otherwise NOT_EXECUTABLE. Each judge receives all six public anchors in one calibration batch and the frozen heldout set in one scoring batch. No blind rerun or provider/API fallback.

sealed_pack.reuse_rule: Reuse an intact frozen pack only when its freshness and integrity remain valid after this addendum; otherwise regenerate once under the existing integrity protocol after this addendum is frozen, independently review, encrypt, and freeze before any scored candidate call.

exact_release_gate_order: sealed no-model transport and structure preflight passes without exposing hidden content
candidate filesystem-denial sentinel and context-separation canary pass
each judge independently passes all 6 public calibration anchors
exact unscored candidate canary passes; then stop and record evidence
an evaluator explicitly authorizes the frozen 24-case scored run
execute each candidate fixture once with zero professional retries
both isolated judges grade the frozen outputs once
apply unchanged conservative aggregation, hard fails, thresholds, and contrastive rules
write a replayable private run record and sanitized public report
return PASS only if core and later post-core gates pass; fail closed otherwise
